## [​](https://docs.vast.ai/guides/reference/faq/networking#port-configuration)  Port Configuration
### [​](https://docs.vast.ai/guides/reference/faq/networking#how-can-i-open-custom-ports)  How can I open custom ports?
```
-p 8081:8081 -p 8082:8082
```

```
65.130.162.74:33526 -> 8081/tcp
```

```
python -m http.server 8081
```

### [​](https://docs.vast.ai/guides/reference/faq/networking#how-can-i-open-an-identity-port-map-like-3200132001-where-external-are-the-same)  How can I open an identity port map like 32001:32001 where external are the same?
```
-p 70000:70000 -p 70001:70001
```
